DiagnosticLevel.description: Payload size for diagnostics (independent of structural `detailLevel`).

oneOf.description: Plus raw traceback / full TD dumps.

OpPath.description: Operator path string passed to TD for resolution via `td.op()`.

Pid.description: OS process id — sole address for tools and queues.

baseline.description:
A previous `observation` from this tool, to compare against.

Must be a stamped observation. A bare projection is refused: it cannot
be shown to be a read of anything, so a delta against it would carry a
freshness claim nothing backs.

capture.description: Take a fresh read and return it for retention, instead of comparing.

contextPath.description: Optional context path for resolving relative `paths`.

daemonId.description: Optional federated daemon id (omit for local / unique remote resolve).

diagnosticLevel.description: Diagnostic payload size (`summary` omits raw traceback).

fields.description:
Fields to project per path, e.g. `par.t`, `comment`, `wire.input.0`.

Only these fields are compared. An unrequested field is not evidence of
anything, so it is absent from the result rather than reported as
unchanged.

paths.description: Operator paths to read, both sides.
